judgement.reason: Stirling PDF is a single-image web app whose helper processes can be run in one container with a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script scripts/init-without-ocr.sh runs 6 long-running servers in the background (), create_office_profile_template, start_unoserver_demand_manager, env -u) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown lines of the Dockerfile and the start script do not prove that the production image avoids starting several long-running background servers, such as unoserver, in one container.
